creator_feedback_summary: Images are inconsistent across the carousel and the generated faces do not match Aachu/Zuv references. Slide 1 showed Zuv carrying a shawl, while slide 2 removed the shawl, creating a continuity break.

hard_failures.description: Creator judged that the generated Aachu/Zuv faces do not match the reference identities closely enough for final artwork.
hard_failures.likely_cause: The generation path relied on text prompts plus locally viewed reference files rather than a tool/API call that passes the reference images as actual image inputs to the image model.
hard_failures.attempted_repair: Stop accepting current images; require reference-input-aware generation strategy before regenerating.
hard_failures.prevention_note: Do not treat a Python-selected manifest or local path list as sufficient identity conditioning. Each generation/edit attempt must explicitly label visible input images as references or edit targets.

hard_failures.description: Slide 1 visibly introduced the shawl, but slide 2 had no shawl, making the carousel feel inconsistent.
hard_failures.likely_cause: Slide 1 scene lock made the shawl visible while slide 2 prompt explicitly prohibited the shawl.
hard_failures.attempted_repair: Revise slide 1 planning and prompts so the shawl is hidden until the slide 3 reveal.
hard_failures.prevention_note: Use continuity locks: slide 1 no shawl, slide 2 no shawl, slide 3 first visible shawl reveal, slide 4 shawl draped/resting.

hard_failures.description: Some generated post surfaces also malformed the @a.storyof.two brandmark.
hard_failures.likely_cause: Tiny baked-in text is fragile in image generation.
hard_failures.attempted_repair: Do not prioritize brandmark-only retries until identity and continuity are solved.
hard_failures.prevention_note: If imagegen cannot reliably spell the handle, generate clean art and add exact brandmark in final packaging after creator approval.

required_revision.image_strategy: Use actual image references/inputs or mark final imagegen blocked. The current prompt-only built-in call is not enough for identity-sensitive Aachu/Zuv finals.
required_revision.story_continuity: Revise slide 1 to remove visible shawl; keep slide 2 shawl-free; reveal shawl first on slide 3; show shawl resting on slide 4.
